Name: Running Costs Stamina
Author: MangusuPixel
Description:
[size=5]Details[/size]
[list]
[*]By default, running for one second drains 1 unit of stamina.
[*]Walking, riding a horse, moving with a charged tool or running indoors (disabled by default) won't drain stamina.
[*]Don't forget to disable auto-running in the game's settings!
[*]Pairs well with speed buffs including those from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16820]Travelling Skill[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats[/url]﻿ mods.
[*]Includes a configuration file (compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]) for the drain rate and indoors effect.
[*]No dependency other than SMAPI.
[*]The source code is available on [url=https://github.com/MangusuPixel/RunningCostsStamina]GitHub[/url]﻿﻿.
[/list]
